name: Arabic Knowledge Base Composite Textpack
description: Generated source-backed Arabic KB recipe composite for local Wikidata entity extracts and Arabic WordNet lexical-semantic resources.

publishabilityEvidence.productionGradeSourceCoverage: Generated recipe composite over task-supported local Arabic KB resources. Arabic WordNet provides lexical-semantic KB resources; Wikidata provides local entity, alias, relation, canonical KB, quality, and evaluation resources for its declared extract scope.
publishabilityEvidence.auditedLicense: The exact Arabic WordNet v4.1.0 and Wikidata main structured source rows are approved; required component packages carry package-local license evidence for Arabic WordNet CC-BY-4.0 and Wikidata CC0 structured data.
publishabilityEvidence.declaredScope: Arabic KB component composite backed by local Wikidata core entity rows and Arabic WordNet lexical semantics. It does not claim full Wikidata dump coverage, full named-entity-linking coverage, morphology, syntax, corpus, parallel, or full language-composite coverage.

components.reason: Default Arabic lexical-semantic WordNet KB resources.
Default Arabic Wikidata entity labels, aliases, relations, and ontology artifact descriptor.

notes: The required component graph provides local Wikidata Arabic core entity rows, aliases, and relations, plus Arabic WordNet lexical-semantic resources.
Generated component reports and evaluation records are available for the required KB component graph.
